n6da9debbe8.headline: Stock Market: STB and Hexabyte start well
n6da9debbe8.summary: The Tunis Stock Exchange started Friday's session in the red, with the Tunindex falling 0.11% to 7,175.27 points on a total volume of 1.020 million.
n6da9debbe8.why: Tunisia's stock market performance reflects local economic and political conditions, important for regional investors and market watchers.
